answer.summary: E2E job failed because the API never came up. Wait-for-ready polled /api/me for 300s and got HTTP 000 (no connection), and the container log ends with a SpringApplication ERROR after the migrations ran. The exception itself is truncated in the excerpt, so the root cause is not visible. The PR adds migrations and changes startup-adjacent code, so a deterministic startup failure is more likely than a flake. Check the full stack trace of the ERROR at line 1587 before rerunning.
